card.fact_statement: A 9-year-old girl was killed in the first wave of the 2024 Lebanon electronic device attacks.
card.source_span: At least 12 people were killed in the first wave of attacks (17 September), including a 9-year-old girl and an 11-year-old boy.

target_qa_variants.question: ২০২৪ সালের লেবানন ইলেকট্রনিক ডিভাইস হামলার প্রথম দফায় কোন অল্পবয়সী নারী নিহত হয়েছিল?
target_qa_variants.source_span: At least 12 people were killed in the first wave of attacks (17 September), including a 9-year-old girl and an 11-year-old boy.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'young female casualty' as 'অল্পবয়সী নারী' (young female) and 'first wave' as 'প্রথম দফায়' (in the first wave/phase) for natural phrasing in Bengali.

backtranslation_en.question: Which young female was killed in the first wave of the 2024 Lebanon electronic device attacks?
